purpose: Prepare the first complete technical-article translations in all six additional languages without exposing unapproved manuscripts.

review.method: AI self-review against complete English article and standalone target-language reading
review.scope: Title, description, every prose paragraph, table headers, image alt/caption and four diagram steps; code retained byte for byte. Existing source execution statements are translations, not claims of a new run.

limits: AI self-review only; no separate AI session, native speaker or human sign-off.
Structural guards cannot prove semantic fidelity or future source accuracy.
Pilot manuscripts are not accepted by the current en/ko post schema; approved technical publication, output localization and full multilingual route/SEO validation require follow-up implementation.
The full 318 pending news translations were not newly semantically reviewed in this task.
